bio.text: Melissa McDonough won the March 2024 Democratic primary for Texas's 38th Congressional District with 82.58% of the vote, according to Community Impact, and advanced to the November 2024 general election against Rep. Wesley Hunt.
According to her campaign website, she has almost 30 years of experience as a REALTOR and 20 years as a real estate brokerage owner and manager.

Her campaign website says she was Houston chapter president of the Women's Council of Realtors in 2003, is a certified Texas arbitrator, and has worked in Harris County elections as a presiding judge and on election boards; the website's CD38 page says she lives in Tomball.

sources.title: UPDATE: Melissa McDonough to face Wesley Hunt in U.S. Congress District 38 race this November | Cy-Fair - Jersey Village | Community Impact
